UNRATED DIRECTOR'S CUT - THE VERSION THE UNIVERSIDAD IBEROAMERICANA DIDN'T DARE TO SHOW!
"An enigmatic and potent film. Extremely personal and full of ideas. I'd love to see Isaac Ezban approaching a larger format" - Guillermo del Toro, Director (Pan's Labyrinth, Hellboy, Cronos)
"It's crazy, it's funny, you don't know what's gonna happen next, and it was just the most bizarre thing I've ever seen... when it was a curiosity midnight movie, not just a real midnight movie" - Greg Lamberson, Director (Slime City, Slime City Massacre)
